@echo off
echo ================================================================================
echo Creating Scheduled Task for Auto-Backup
echo ================================================================================
echo.
echo This will create a scheduled task that runs every 5 minutes.
echo You may need to run this as Administrator.
echo.
pause

set BACKUP_DIR=%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\cursor-chat-backups
set TASK_NAME=CursorChatAutoBackup

echo.
echo Creating scheduled task: %TASK_NAME%
echo Task will run: %BACKUP_DIR%\auto-backup.bat
echo Frequency: Every 5 minutes
echo.

schtasks /Create /TN "%TASK_NAME%" /TR "%BACKUP_DIR%\auto-backup.bat" /SC MINUTE /MO 5 /F /RL HIGHEST
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Could not create scheduled task automatically.
    echo.
    echo You need to create it manually:
    echo   1. Press Win+R
    echo   2. Type: taskschd.msc
    echo   3. Click "Create Basic Task"
    echo   4. Name: CursorChatAutoBackup
    echo   5. Trigger: Recurring, Every 5 minutes
    echo   6. Action: Start a program
    echo   7. Program: %BACKUP_DIR%\auto-backup.bat
    echo   8. Finish
    echo.
) else (
    echo.
    echo [SUCCESS] Scheduled task created!
    echo.
    echo Task details:
    schtasks /Query /TN "%TASK_NAME%" /FO LIST | findstr /C:"Status" /C:"Next Run Time" /C:"Task To Run"
)

echo.
pause

file:///g%3A/frappe_docker-main/backup_e.content:
@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion

echo ================================================================================
echo COMPLETE ERPNext SYSTEM BACKUP
echo ================================================================================
echo.
echo This script will backup EVERYTHING:
echo   - Database (all data, DocTypes, customizations)
echo   - Site files (private/public files, attachments)
echo   - Docker volumes (sites, logs, database)
echo   - Configuration files (docker-compose, site config)
echo   - Custom apps and code
echo.
echo ================================================================================
echo.

REM Check if Docker is running
docker info >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% NEQ 0 (
    echo ERROR: Docker is not running!
    echo Please start Docker Desktop and try again.
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

REM Set paths
set ERP_DIR=C:\Users\pc\frappe_docker
set COMPOSE_FILE=pwd.yml
set SITE_NAME=frontend

REM Get timestamp for backup folder (consistent format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
for /f "tokens=2 delims==" %%I in ('wmic os get localdatetime /value') do set datetime=%%I
set timestamp=%datetime:~0,4%-%datetime:~4,2%-%datetime:~6,2%_%datetime:~8,2%-%datetime:~10,2%-%datetime:~12,2%
set timestamp_compact=%datetime:~0,4%%datetime:~4,2%%datetime:~6,2%_%datetime:~8,2%%datetime:~10,2%%datetime:~12,2%
set TODAY_DATE=%datetime:~0,4%%datetime:~4,2%%datetime:~6,2%
set CURRENT_TIME=%datetime:~8,2%%datetime:~10,2%%datetime:~12,2%
set BACKUP_ROOT=G:\frappe_docker-main\ERPNext_Backups
set BACKUP_FOLDER=%BACKUP_ROOT%\ERPNext_Backup_%timestamp%

echo [Configuration]
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo   ERPNext Directory: %ERP_DIR%
echo   Compose File: %COMPOSE_FILE%
echo   Site Name: %SITE_NAME%
echo   Backup Location: %BACKUP_FOLDER%
echo.

REM Create backup directory structure
echo [Step 1/11] Creating backup directory structure...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if not exist "%BACKUP_ROOT%" mkdir "%BACKUP_ROOT%"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\custom_apps" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\custom_apps"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations"
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs"
echo   ✓ Backup directories created
echo.

REM Change to ERPNext directory
cd /d "%ERP_DIR%"

REM Get container names
echo [Step 2/11] Detecting containers...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps -q backend > "%TEMP%\backend_container.txt" 2>nul
set /p BACKEND_CONTAINER=<"%TEMP%\backend_container.txt"
if "%BACKEND_CONTAINER%"=="" (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Backend container not found. Trying to start services...
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% up -d backend
    timeout /t 10 /nobreak >nul
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps -q backend > "%TEMP%\backend_container.txt" 2>nul
    set /p BACKEND_CONTAINER=<"%TEMP%\backend_container.txt"
)

docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps -q db > "%TEMP%\db_container.txt" 2>nul
set /p DB_CONTAINER=<"%TEMP%\db_container.txt"

if "%BACKEND_CONTAINER%"=="" (
    echo   ✗ ERROR: Could not find or start backend container
    echo   Please ensure ERPNext is running: docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% up -d
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

echo   ✓ Backend container: %BACKEND_CONTAINER:~0,12%...
if not "%DB_CONTAINER%"=="" (
    echo   ✓ Database container: %DB_CONTAINER:~0,12%...
)
echo.

REM Backup database using bench backup - FORCE FRESH BACKUP
echo [Step 3/11] Creating fresh database backup (this may take a few minutes)...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

echo   Current date/time: %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME% (YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS format)
echo   Creating fresh backup NOW...
echo   Running bench backup command (this will create a NEW backup file)...

REM Record start time
set BACKUP_START_TIME=%time%

REM Run bench backup - this creates a NEW backup file
echo   Starting bench backup process...
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% exec -T backend bench --site %SITE_NAME% backup --with-files --compress > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\bench_backup.log" 2>&1
set BENCH_EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%

if %BENCH_EXIT_CODE% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Bench backup command completed
    echo   Waiting for backup file to be created and verified...
    
    REM Wait/retry logic: Wait up to 60 seconds for backup file to appear and be complete
    set WAIT_COUNT=0
    set MAX_WAIT=30
    set BACKUP_FOUND=NO
    set BACKUP_VERIFIED=NO
    
    :wait_for_backup
    REM Get the newest backup file (sorted by modification time)
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "ls -1t /home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/private/backups/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1" > "%TEMP%\newest_backup.txt" 2>nul
    set /p NEWEST_BACKUP=<"%TEMP%\newest_backup.txt"
    set NEWEST_BACKUP=%NEWEST_BACKUP: =%
    
    if not "%NEWEST_BACKUP%"=="" (
        REM Extract filename
        for %%F in ("%NEWEST_BACKUP%") do set NEWEST_FILE=%%~nxF
        
        REM Check if it's from today (format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS)
        echo %NEWEST_FILE% | findstr "%TODAY_DATE%" >nul 2>&1
        if !ERRORLEVEL! EQU 0 (
            set BACKUP_FOUND=YES
            
            REM Verify file size (should be > 0 bytes, typically > 100KB)
            docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "stat -c%%s '%NEWEST_BACKUP%' 2>/dev/null" > "%TEMP%\backup_size.txt" 2>nul
            set /p BACKUP_SIZE=<"%TEMP%\backup_size.txt"
            set BACKUP_SIZE=%BACKUP_SIZE: =%
            
            if not "%BACKUP_SIZE%"=="" (
                REM Check if file size is reasonable (> 100KB = 102400 bytes)
                if !BACKUP_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
                    echo   ✓ Backup file found: %NEWEST_FILE%
                    echo   ✓ File size verified: %BACKUP_SIZE% bytes (~%BACKUP_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
                    echo   ✓ Date verified: Matches today (%TODAY_DATE%)
                    set BACKUP_VERIFIED=YES
                    goto :backup_verified
                ) else (
                    echo   ⚠ Backup file exists but size is too small: %BACKUP_SIZE% bytes
                    echo   Waiting for backup to complete...
                )
            ) else (
                echo   ⚠ Could not verify backup file size, waiting...
            )
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ Found backup file but date doesn't match today: %NEWEST_FILE%
            echo   Expected date prefix: %TODAY_DATE%
            echo   Waiting for today's backup to be created...
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ Backup file not found yet, waiting... (%WAIT_COUNT%/%MAX_WAIT%)
    )
    
    set /a WAIT_COUNT+=1
    if !WAIT_COUNT! LSS %MAX_WAIT% (
        timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul
        goto :wait_for_backup
    )
    
    REM If we get here, backup wasn't verified
    if "%BACKUP_FOUND%"=="YES" (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Backup file found but verification incomplete
        echo   File: %NEWEST_FILE%
        echo   Will use this backup but recommend manual verification
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not find fresh backup file after waiting
        echo   Will create direct database dump as fallback...
        goto :create_direct_dump
    )
    
    :backup_verified
    echo   ✓✓✓ FRESH BACKUP VERIFIED: Date and size check passed ✓✓✓
) else (
    :create_direct_dump
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Bench backup command failed or verification incomplete
    echo   Attempting direct database dump (always fresh)...
    
    REM Try mysqldump as fallback - this ALWAYS creates fresh backup
    echo   Creating fresh database dump using mysqldump...
    set DUMP_FILE=FRESH_BACKUP_%TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%.sql
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% exec -T db mysqldump -u root -padmin --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --triggers > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%" 2>"%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\mysqldump.log"
    
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        REM Verify dump file size
        for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%") do set DUMP_SIZE=%%~zF
        if !DUMP_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
            echo   ✓✓✓ FRESH database dump created: %DUMP_FILE% ✓✓✓
            echo   ✓ File size: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes (~%DUMP_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
            echo   ✓ This is a FRESH backup with current data from %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: Dump file created but size is suspicious: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes
            echo   Check logs: %BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\mysqldump.log
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ✗ ERROR: Database backup failed!
        echo   Check logs: %BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\mysqldump.log
    )
)
echo.

REM Copy ONLY THE FRESHEST backup file from container (created just now)
echo [Step 4/11] Copying FRESH backup files from container...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
set BACKUP_SOURCE=/home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/private/backups

REM Create backups directory
if not exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups" mkdir "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups"

echo   Looking for backup files from TODAY (%TODAY_DATE%)...

REM Get the LATEST backup file from TODAY (sorted by modification time, newest first)
REM Filter by today's date to ensure we only get fresh backups
docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "ls -1t %BACKUP_SOURCE%/*%TODAY_DATE%*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1" > "%TEMP%\today_backup.txt" 2>nul
set /p TODAY_BACKUP=<"%TEMP%\today_backup.txt"
set TODAY_BACKUP=%TODAY_BACKUP: =%

REM If no backup from today, get the absolute latest (just created)
if "%TODAY_BACKUP%"=="" (
    echo   No backup found with today's date, getting latest backup file...
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "ls -1t %BACKUP_SOURCE%/*.sql.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1" > "%TEMP%\latest_backup.txt" 2>nul
    set /p LATEST_BACKUP=<"%TEMP%\latest_backup.txt"
    set LATEST_BACKUP=%LATEST_BACKUP: =%
    set BACKUP_TO_USE=%LATEST_BACKUP%
) else (
    set BACKUP_TO_USE=%TODAY_BACKUP%
)

if not "%BACKUP_TO_USE%"=="" (
    echo   Found backup: %BACKUP_TO_USE%
    REM Extract just the filename (handle full path)
    for %%F in ("%BACKUP_TO_USE%") do set BACKUP_FILE=%%~nxF
    
    REM Get file size before copying
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "stat -c%%s '%BACKUP_TO_USE%' 2>/dev/null" > "%TEMP%\source_size.txt" 2>nul
    set /p SOURCE_SIZE=<"%TEMP%\source_size.txt"
    set SOURCE_SIZE=%SOURCE_SIZE: =%
    
    REM Copy the backup file
    echo   Copying FRESH backup: %BACKUP_FILE%
    echo   Source file size: %SOURCE_SIZE% bytes (~%SOURCE_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
    docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:%BACKUP_TO_USE% "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%BACKUP_FILE%" 2>nul
    
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        REM Verify copied file size matches source
        for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%BACKUP_FILE%") do set COPIED_SIZE=%%~zF
        
        if "%COPIED_SIZE%"=="%SOURCE_SIZE%" (
            echo   ✓ Database backup copied successfully
            echo   ✓ File size verified: %COPIED_SIZE% bytes (~%COPIED_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
            
            REM Verify it's from today
            echo %BACKUP_FILE% | findstr "%TODAY_DATE%" >nul 2>&1
            if !ERRORLEVEL! EQU 0 (
                echo   ✓✓✓ VERIFIED: Backup is from TODAY (%TODAY_DATE%) - FRESH DATA! ✓✓✓
                set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=YES
            ) else (
                echo   ⚠ WARNING: Backup file date doesn't match today
                echo   Backup file: %BACKUP_FILE%
                echo   Today's date: %TODAY_DATE%
                echo   This backup may contain OLD data!
                set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=NO
            )
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: File size mismatch after copy
            echo   Source: %SOURCE_SIZE% bytes, Copied: %COPIED_SIZE% bytes
        )
        
        REM Also copy matching files.tgz if exists
        set FILES_BACKUP=%BACKUP_FILE:.sql.gz=-files.tgz%
        docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:%BACKUP_SOURCE%/%FILES_BACKUP% "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%FILES_BACKUP%" >nul 2>&1
        if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
            echo   ✓ Files backup copied: %FILES_BACKUP%
        )
        
        REM Copy site_config_backup.json if exists
        set CONFIG_BACKUP=%BACKUP_FILE:.sql.gz=-site_config_backup.json%
        docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:%BACKUP_SOURCE%/%CONFIG_BACKUP% "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%CONFIG_BACKUP%" >nul 2>&1
        if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
            echo   ✓ Config backup copied: %CONFIG_BACKUP%
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ✗ ERROR: Could not copy backup file
        echo   Trying alternative: Direct database dump...
        goto :create_direct_dump
    )
) else (
    :create_direct_dump
    echo   ✗ ERROR: Could not find any backup files
    echo   Creating direct database dump as fallback...
    
    REM Create direct dump - this is ALWAYS fresh
    set DUMP_FILE=FRESH_BACKUP_%TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%.sql
    docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% exec -T db mysqldump -u root -padmin --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --triggers > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%" 2>"%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\direct_dump.log"
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\%DUMP_FILE%") do set DUMP_SIZE=%%~zF
        if !DUMP_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
            echo   ✓✓✓ FRESH backup created: %DUMP_FILE% ✓✓✓
            echo   ✓ File size: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes (~%DUMP_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
            echo   ✓ This backup contains CURRENT DATA from %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%
            set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=YES
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: Dump file size is suspicious: %DUMP_SIZE% bytes
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ✗ ERROR: All backup methods failed!
    )
)
echo.

REM Export customizations as JSON (Scripts, DocTypes as separate files)
echo [Step 5/11] Exporting ALL customizations (DocTypes, Scripts, Fields, Settings, Users, etc.)...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
REM Copy export script to container
set SCRIPT_DIR=%~dp0
set CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED=NO

if exist "%SCRIPT_DIR%export_customizations.py" (
    echo   Copying export script to container...
    docker cp "%SCRIPT_DIR%export_customizations.py" %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/tmp/export_customizations.py >nul 2>&1
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        echo   ✓ Export script copied
        echo   Running comprehensive export script...
        echo   This will export: Scripts, DocTypes, Fields, Settings, Users, Roles, etc.
        
        REM Run export script via bench console using Python directly
        docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench && python3 -c \"import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/home/frappe/frappe-bench'); import frappe; frappe.init(site='%SITE_NAME%'); frappe.connect(); exec(open('/tmp/export_customizations.py').read())\"" > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\customizations_export.log" 2>&1
        
        REM Wait a moment for export to complete
        timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul
        
        REM Copy exported customizations
        echo   Copying exported customizations...
        docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/tmp/customizations_export "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations" >nul 2>&1
        if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
            REM Verify export was successful
            if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\export_summary.json" (
                echo   ✓ Customizations exported successfully
                echo   ✓ Export summary created
                
                REM Count exported files
                set /a EXPORT_COUNT=0
                for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\*.json") do set /a EXPORT_COUNT+=1
                echo   ✓ Exported %EXPORT_COUNT% JSON files
                
                REM List key exports
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\client_scripts.json" (
                    echo   ✓ Client Scripts exported as separate JSON file
                )
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\server_scripts.json" (
                    echo   ✓ Server Scripts exported as separate JSON file
                )
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\doctype_definitions_complete.json" (
                    echo   ✓ DocType definitions exported as separate JSON file
                )
                if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\custom_fields.json" (
                    echo   ✓ Custom Fields exported as separate JSON file
                )
                
                set CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED=YES
            ) else (
                echo   ⚠ WARNING: Export completed but summary file not found
            )
        ) else (
            echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not copy exported customizations
        )
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not copy export script to container
    )
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Export script not found at: %SCRIPT_DIR%export_customizations.py
)

REM Fallback: Use bench export-customizations if Python script failed
if "%CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED%"=="NO" (
    echo   Trying bench export-customizations as fallback...
    docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% bash -c "cd /home/frappe/frappe-bench && bench --site %SITE_NAME% export-customizations /tmp/customizations_export_fallback" > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\bench_export.log" 2>&1
    docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/tmp/customizations_export_fallback "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations" >nul 2>&1
    if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
        echo   ✓ Customizations exported using bench export-customizations
        set CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED=YES
    ) else (
        echo   ⚠ WARNING: Customizations export failed
        echo   Note: Scripts and DocTypes are still in database backup
        echo   Check logs: %BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\customizations_export.log
    )
)
echo.

REM Copy site files
echo [Step 6/11] Copying site files (private and public)...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
REM Copy private files
docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/private "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files\private" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Private files copied
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not copy private files
)

REM Copy public files
docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/public "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files\public" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Public files copied
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not copy public files
)
echo.

REM Backup Docker volumes
echo [Step 7/11] Backing up Docker volumes...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
REM Get volume names
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% config --volumes > "%TEMP%\volumes.txt" 2>nul

REM Backup sites volume
docker run --rm -v frappe_docker_sites:/data -v "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes":/backup alpine tar czf /backup/sites_volume.tar.gz -C /data . >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Sites volume backed up
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not backup sites volume
)

REM Backup logs volume
docker run --rm -v frappe_docker_logs:/data -v "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes":/backup alpine tar czf /backup/logs_volume.tar.gz -C /data . >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Logs volume backed up
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not backup logs volume
)

REM Backup database volume
docker run --rm -v frappe_docker_db-data:/data -v "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes":/backup alpine tar czf /backup/db-data_volume.tar.gz -C /data . >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Database volume backed up
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not backup database volume (may not exist)
)
echo.

REM Backup configuration files
echo [Step 8/11] Backing up configuration files...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
copy "%ERP_DIR%\%COMPOSE_FILE%" "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config\%COMPOSE_FILE%" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Docker Compose file backed up
)

copy "%ERP_DIR%\common_site_config.json" "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config\common_site_config.json" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Common site config backed up
)

REM Copy site config from container
docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/%SITE_NAME%/site_config.json "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config\site_config.json" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   ✓ Site config backed up
)

REM Copy .env file if exists
if exist "%ERP_DIR%\.env" (
    copy "%ERP_DIR%\.env" "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config\.env" >nul 2>&1
    echo   ✓ Environment file backed up
)
echo.

REM Backup custom apps
echo [Step 9/11] Backing up custom apps...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
docker exec %BACKEND_CONTAINER% ls -1 /home/frappe/frappe-bench/apps > "%TEMP%\apps_list.txt" 2>nul
if %ERRORLEVEL% EQU 0 (
    echo   Checking for custom apps...
    findstr /V "frappe erpnext" "%TEMP%\apps_list.txt" > "%TEMP%\custom_apps.txt" 2>nul
    if exist "%TEMP%\custom_apps.txt" (
        for /f %%a in (%TEMP%\custom_apps.txt) do (
            echo   Backing up app: %%a
            docker cp %BACKEND_CONTAINER%:/home/frappe/frappe-bench/apps/%%a "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\custom_apps\%%a" >nul 2>&1
        )
        echo   ✓ Custom apps backed up
    ) else (
        echo   ℹ No custom apps found
    )
) else (
    echo   ⚠ WARNING: Could not list apps
)
echo.

REM Create comprehensive backup verification
echo [Step 10/11] Verifying backup completeness...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
REM Create verification checklist
(
echo BACKUP VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
echo ================================================================================
echo Backup Date: %timestamp%
echo Backup Location: %BACKUP_FOLDER%
echo.
echo VERIFICATION:
) > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"

REM Check each component
if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\*.sql.gz" (
    echo   ✓ Database backup file exists >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ✗ Database backup file MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files\private" (
    echo   ✓ Private files backed up >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ✗ Private files MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\files\public" (
    echo   ✓ Public files backed up >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ✗ Public files MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes\sites_volume.tar.gz" (
    echo   ✓ Sites volume backed up >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ✗ Sites volume MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\volumes\db-data_volume.tar.gz" (
    echo   ✓ Database volume backed up >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ✗ Database volume MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\export_summary.json" (
    echo   ✓ Customizations exported >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ⚠ Customizations export MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config\pwd.yml" (
    echo   ✓ Configuration files backed up >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
) else (
    echo   ✗ Configuration files MISSING >> "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.txt"
)

echo   ✓ Verification checklist created
echo.

REM Create backup info file
echo [Step 11/11] Creating backup information file...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

REM Get backup file date and size for verification
set BACKUP_FILE_DATE=
set BACKUP_FILE_SIZE=0
set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=NO

REM Check for .sql.gz files first
if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\*.sql.gz" (
    for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\*.sql.gz") do (
        set BACKUP_FILE_DATE=%%~nF
        set BACKUP_FILE_SIZE=%%~zF
        echo %BACKUP_FILE_DATE% | findstr "%TODAY_DATE%" >nul 2>&1
        if !ERRORLEVEL! EQU 0 (
            if !BACKUP_FILE_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
                set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=YES
            )
        )
        goto :found_backup_file
    )
)

REM Check for direct .sql dump files
if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\*.sql" (
    for %%F in ("%BACKUP_FOLDER%\database\backups\*.sql") do (
        set BACKUP_FILE_DATE=%%~nF
        set BACKUP_FILE_SIZE=%%~zF
        echo %BACKUP_FILE_DATE% | findstr "%TODAY_DATE%" >nul 2>&1
        if !ERRORLEVEL! EQU 0 (
            if !BACKUP_FILE_SIZE! GTR 102400 (
                set BACKUP_IS_FRESH=YES
            )
        )
        goto :found_backup_file
    )
)

:found_backup_file

(
echo ERPNext Complete System Backup
echo ================================================================================
echo Backup Created: %timestamp%
echo Backup File Date: %BACKUP_FILE_DATE%
echo Site Name: %SITE_NAME%
echo ERPNext Directory: %ERP_DIR%
echo.
if "%BACKUP_IS_FRESH%"=="YES" (
    echo ✓✓✓ BACKUP STATUS: FRESH DATA FROM TODAY (%TODAY_DATE%) ✓✓✓
    echo Backup file: %BACKUP_FILE_DATE%
    echo Backup size: %BACKUP_FILE_SIZE% bytes (~%BACKUP_FILE_SIZE:~0,-3% KB)
    echo This backup contains CURRENT data from %timestamp%
    echo Date format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS (verified)
    echo File size: Verified (^> 100KB)
) else (
    echo ⚠⚠⚠ WARNING: Backup file verification failed ⚠⚠⚠
    echo Backup file: %BACKUP_FILE_DATE%
    echo Backup size: %BACKUP_FILE_SIZE% bytes
    echo Today's date: %TODAY_DATE%
    if "%BACKUP_FILE_SIZE%"=="0" (
        echo File size check: FAILED (file may be empty or missing)
    ) else (
        echo File size check: PASSED
    )
    echo Please verify this backup contains current data!
)
echo.
echo Backup Contents:
echo   ✓ Database: Fresh backup with all CURRENT data from %TODAY_DATE%_%CURRENT_TIME%
echo   ✓ Files: Private and public files, attachments
echo   ✓ Volumes: Docker volumes (sites, logs, database)
echo   ✓ Config: Docker Compose, site configuration
if "%CUSTOMIZATIONS_EXPORTED%"=="YES" (
    echo   ✓ Customizations: DocTypes, Scripts, Fields exported as SEPARATE JSON files
) else (
    echo   ⚠ Customizations: In database backup only (export failed)
)
echo   ✓ Custom Apps: Any custom applications
echo.
echo Verification Details:
echo   Date format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS (consistent)
echo   Backup date: %BACKUP_FILE_DATE%
echo   Backup size: %BACKUP_FILE_SIZE% bytes
if "%BACKUP_IS_FRESH%"=="YES" (
    echo   Status: ✓ VERIFIED FRESH DATA
) else (
    echo   Status: ⚠ VERIFICATION FAILED
)
echo.
echo Customizations Export:
if exist "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\customizations\export_summary.json" (
    echo   ✓ Client Scripts exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ Server Scripts exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ DocType definitions exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ Custom Fields exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ Property Setters exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ Workflows exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ Reports exported as separate JSON file
    echo   ✓ Users, Roles, Settings exported as separate JSON files
) else (
    echo   ⚠ Customizations are in database backup only
    echo   (Scripts and DocTypes can be extracted from database backup)
)
echo.
echo To restore this backup, use: restore_erpnext_from_backup.bat
echo Or follow the instructions in: RESTORE_ERPNext_GUIDE.md
echo.
echo Backup Location: %BACKUP_FOLDER%
) > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\BACKUP_INFO.txt"

echo   ✓ Backup information file created
echo.

REM Create system state snapshot
echo [Finalizing] Creating system state snapshot...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% ps > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\container_status.txt" 2>nul
docker compose -f %COMPOSE_FILE% config > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\config\docker_compose_full.yml" 2>nul
docker images > "%BACKUP_FOLDER%\logs\docker_images.txt" 2>nul
echo   ✓ System state snapshot created
echo.

REM Calculate backup size
echo [Finalizing] Calculating backup size...
echo --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
for /f "tokens=3" %%a in ('dir /s /-c "%BACKUP_FOLDER%" ^| findstr /i "bytes"') do set size=%%a
echo   Backup size: ~%size% bytes
echo.

echo ================================================================================
echo BACKUP COMPLETE!
echo ================================================================================
echo.
echo Backup Location: %BACKUP_FOLDER%
echo.
echo Backup Contents:
echo   ✓ Database backup (ALL data, DocTypes, customizations, scripts)
echo   ✓ Site files (private/public, ALL attachments and uploaded files)
echo   ✓ Docker volumes (sites, logs, database - COMPLETE snapshots)
echo   ✓ Configuration files (Docker Compose, site configs, environment)
echo   ✓ Customizations (Scripts, DocTypes, Fields, Settings, Users, Roles)
echo   ✓ Custom apps (if any)
echo   ✓ System state snapshot (containers, images, status)
echo.
echo This backup contains EVERYTHING needed to restore your ERPNext system
echo to the exact state at: %timestamp%
echo.
echo IMPORTANT: Store this backup in a safe location!
echo           You can restore from this backup if something goes wrong.
echo.
echo Next Steps:
echo   1. Test the backup by checking the backup folder
echo   2. Store backup in external drive or cloud storage
echo   3. Keep multiple backup versions for safety
echo.
pause
